summary.text: Suzy Glowiak Hilton (Suzanne Glowiak Hilton on Ballotpedia) is a Democratic member of the Illinois State Senate representing District 23 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An engineer by profession, she previously served as a trustee of the Village of Western Springs.

paragraphs.text: Glowiak Hilton lives in Western Springs, Illinois.
She earned a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from the Illinois Institute of Technology in 1983 and a master's degree in manufacturing engineering from Northwestern University in 1997.
Her career experience includes working as a senior mechanical engineer with CED Technologies, Inc. and as an affiliated consultant with Wiss, Janney, Elstner Assoc. Inc.
Glowiak Hilton served as a trustee of the Village of Western Springs and on a local recreation commission.

In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, Glowiak Hilton listed her top priorities as property tax relief, gun reform to prevent illegal guns from coming into the state, and affordable, quality health care for all citizens and the elderly.
